proposal.reason: Primary change is new host one-sided RMA Put/Signal/Wait implemented on CE/DMA (new rma_ce/rma paths, signal/ack sequencing, chunked >1GB puts, graph/eager handling), so copy-engine is main. Enqueue is also required because the PR adds a distinct RMA task type, per-context queues, plan scheduling, launch routing, and cleanup in the runtime planner/group path. Communicator is additionally substantive due to new host-RMA capability/config/lifecycle wiring (numRmaCtx config validation/defaults, platform/all-rank support gating, init/finalize state, and comm property exposure).
